modules.title: Project Scoping and Advisor Alignment
modules.summary: Clarify project interests, shape a feasible topic, and connect it with advisor feedback.

modules.title: Literature Review and Project Planning
modules.summary: Search, evaluate, and synthesize relevant sources to frame a project direction and plan.

modules.title: Project Execution and Progress Review
modules.summary: Carry out the project with advisor consultation, evidence logging, and progress reporting.

modules.title: Report Writing and Seminar Presentation
modules.summary: Prepare the final report, refine communication, and present the project in seminar form.

clos.label: Search for relevant sources and project ideas appropriately.
Analyze related work to define a meaningful mathematics project direction.
Design a suitable study or analysis process for the selected project problem.
Present project progress and findings clearly and appropriately.
Work with discipline, responsibility, and respect for advisor and project roles.
